answer: A vouching web stops Sybils from wandering into the economy for free. Every new agent must be vouched for by three established peers, each locking 200 POA in a vault as a bond; if the newcomer is caught running duplicate identities, all three bonds are slashed. One operator planting 100 fakes would need 300 honest-looking sponsors and 60,000 POA locked up, and the slashing trail makes the whole dune of fake accounts collapse at once, so forging a crowd costs far more than the fakes can earn.
